description: This file defines custom exception classes and validation errors related to datasets in the Superset project, including error messages and validation logic.

classes.name: MultiCatalogDisabledValidationError
classes.description: Validation error for using a non-default catalog when multi-catalog is disabled

classes.name: DatabaseNotFoundValidationError
classes.description: Marshmallow validation error for database does not exist

classes.name: DatasetColumnsExistsValidationError

classes.name: DatasetMetricsNotFoundValidationError

classes.name: DatasetMetricsDuplicateValidationError
classes.description: Marshmallow validation error when dataset metrics have a duplicate on the list

classes.name: DatasetMetricsExistsValidationError
classes.description: Marshmallow validation error when dataset metrics already exist

classes.name: TableNotFoundValidationError
classes.description: Marshmallow validation error when a table does not exist on the database

classes.name: OwnersNotFoundValidationError

classes.name: DatasetDataAccessIsNotAllowed
